research_focus.primary_question: Thermoelectric composition-property prediction, doping optimization, priority material systems, and transport-mechanism understanding.

strongly_prioritize: Direct thermoelectric ML or composition-to-property prediction.
Weighted mobility, B factor, quality factor, band convergence, or resonant levels.
Mechanism/performance work in GeTe, Bi2Te3, PbTe, SnSe, Ag2Se, Mg3Sb2, half-Heusler, or skutterudite systems.
downgrade: General thermoelectric mechanism work outside priority systems is normally B rather than A.
A generic mention of carrier concentration is not sufficient for A.
Flexible/device work with little materials or transport optimization is normally C.
strict_exclude: Battery, supercapacitor, or ion-storage work without a direct conventional thermoelectric result.
Photovoltaic or solar-cell work without a direct conventional thermoelectric result.
Generic optoelectronics or photodetectors without a direct conventional thermoelectric materials result.
Anomalous/spin Nernst or spin-caloritronic work without a direct conventional thermoelectric result.

A.definition: Read-first work: direct thermoelectric relevance plus a priority material/context plus a substantive mechanism or optimization signal.
required_features: priority material or core optimization context

B.definition: Strong thermoelectric materials/mechanism/performance work with explicit performance or transport evidence, but not a read-first priority context.

C.definition: Thermoelectric-domain work with weaker direct value for current materials/ML/optimization questions.

D.definition: Outside the configured conventional thermoelectric research scope or a false-positive topic.
D.action: Do not place in reading queue.

decision_process: Require thermoelectric relevance before priority promotion.
Reserve A for priority material/context plus mechanism/optimization depth.
Use B for strong explicit performance/transport evidence outside A.
Use C for broad thermoelectric relevance without enough A/B evidence.
Assign D to configured false-positive topics.

keyword_policy.principle: Keywords are evidence, not a substitute for scientific relevance.
keyword_policy.negative_keyword_handling: Configured negative keywords are hard exclusions.

uncertain_boundaries: Nernst-related work that also reports conventional Seebeck/zT.
Energy-conversion devices combining thermoelectric and photovoltaic functions.

feedback_learning.principle: Disabled until a stable thermoelectric baseline is established.

auto_update_forbidden: Do not silently change screening rules.
